BELIEVER-OMNISCIENCE_POWER.title: Omniscience
BELIEVER-OMNISCIENCE_POWER.description:
Cards cost 0 and you take no HP loss.
Ends when the enemy's turn ends.
BELIEVER-OMNISCIENCE_POWER.smartDescript:
Cards cost 0 and you take no HP loss.

BELIEVER-ARMY_OF_THE_LORD_POWER.title: Lord of Hosts
BELIEVER-ARMY_OF_THE_LORD_POWER.descript:
Whenever you play an ordinary card, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.
Triggers up to 8 times.
BELIEVER-ARMY_OF_THE_LORD_POWER.smartDes:
Whenever you play an ordinary card, deal 5 damage to ALL enemies.

BELIEVER-LOAVES_AND_FISHES_POWER.smartDe: Copies created by Five Loaves and Two Fish disappear at the end of your turn.
